additional_info.subject: RE: ID0388043-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R0 170002826] Internal error CRM:01811000423
additional_info.body:
Good morning Sascha,
I am reaching out regarding ticket
ID0388043
, for charger
9fMioJ.
The ticket is opened for outlet 1 out of order.
After connecting remotely to the charger and having a detailed analysis, I believe that the EcoG-LE is faulty on this charger, leading to Outlet 1 going out of order.  I connected via ssh to the EcoG-LE, and I noticed that the Pilot state is in “Invalid” status, and that there is the error “could not configure local station for slac”, as per picture below:
This error is not reflected in SCB logs, and it is a known EcoG failure due to internal communication problem. The only solution, at the moment, is to replace the EcoG-LE controller.
Please be aware that we are working along with EcoG team to resolve the issue, hence I am requesting you to send the faulty unit back to the factory for analysis.
Therefore, please replace the EcoG-LE as soon as possible, so to make outlet DC1 available again, and please share the faulty EcoG serial number to me once onsite.
Looking forward to hearing from you soon!
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
Smart Infrastructure
